subject.title: [Bug/Docs]: local+hybrid memory_search quality can appear unstable due to extraPaths path drift + benchmark-file contamination

question: Should OpenClaw add a public memorySearch exclusion/path-hygiene contract now, and should it cover builtin indexing only or builtin plus QMD/status/docs/index identity together?
rationale: The request changes public memorySearch configuration and indexed recall semantics, and repository policy treats that as compatibility-sensitive rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Repair narrow builtin exclusion first
options.body: Land the open exclusion PR or successor after fixing default/per-agent merge semantics, index identity coverage, and explicit builtin-only documentation while tracking QMD and diagnostics separately.

options.title: Require cross-backend contract
options.body: Pause exclusion work until builtin, QMD, watcher behavior, stale-index cleanup, docs, and diagnostics share one accepted exclusion model.

options.title: Docs and diagnostics only
options.body: Defer a public exclusion config and focus on clearer path-drift, broad-extraPaths, and benchmark-contamination guidance plus status warnings.

recommendation.title: Repair narrow builtin exclusion first
recommendation.body: Land the open exclusion PR or successor after fixing default/per-agent merge semantics, index identity coverage, and explicit builtin-only documentation while tracking QMD and diagnostics separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current-history signal for the memory host, schema, docs, and index-identity boundary involved in this config decision.
